name: Haen
description: Keeper of the Clan Tree and Nohr's former friend; Aylith's father.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen is chosen as Keeper of the Tree and sworn to protect it; Nohr grows jealous.
timeline.quote: Nohr grew jealous at his friend's new status.

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr splits the Clan Tree despite Haen's protests, causing the Parting and killing the tree.
timeline.quote: Despite Haen's heavy protesting, Nohr split the tree, causing Haen to fall out of its branches to the ground

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen sleeps frozen in time, then wakes three weeks later with fire in his fingers and reawakens the tree's remnants with a new ritual.
timeline.quote: Haen woke up and had a fire in his fingers

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen becomes known as the First, a Keeper without a tree, and plants a warded thornwood wall to defend Inys Haen.
timeline.quote: Haen then became known as the First, a Keeper without a tree to keep

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
timeline.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen awakes and performs the awakening ritual, bringing spring to his lands.
timeline.quote: For several weeks there is no end to the winter until Haen finally awakes.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohrish soldiers raid Inys Haen to capture the Keeper and Aylith.
timeline.quote: 519 years after the Parting, the destruction of the Clan Tree, Nohrish soldiers descended from the mountains, and launch a raid on Inys Haen

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thix starts fires and attacks Aylith; the Keeper and his wife die and RoNal kills Thix.
timeline.quote: The Keeper and his wife die in the fire and RoNal is forced to kill Thix.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and together they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn, fulfilling Haen's prophecy.
timeline.quote: the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: former friend who attacked the Tree; his people attack Inys Haen
relations.quote: To defend Inys Haen from semiannual Nohrish attacks
